name: Kelter
description: Kelter runtime as an A2A agent. A delegated task becomes a governed, durable kernel run: every action the model proposes is validated by the kernel and journaled, and the task inherits Kelter's durability — it survives a server crash and resumes without re-executing. Policy: local:qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct.

skills.name: Run a governed, durable task
skills.description: Execute a self-contained task through the Kelter kernel (validated + journaled + durable).

bearer.description: Bearer token required for all task methods (message/send, tasks/get, tasks/cancel). Card discovery is unauthenticated.
